relationships.subject: b
relationships.notes: Former lovers, intellectual equals. B's grief after Noor's disappearance was attenuated, not severed, under Noor's own contingency agreement with Asterion.

relationships.subject: tomas-vale
relationships.notes: Forty-three years. Severed by a mediocre-practitioner correction seven months before the Halloway cake appeared.

relationships.subject: tomas-vale
relationships.notes: Two hundred eighty-seven documented birthday-cake purchases in the final ten years alone. Not reconciled by the employment correction — it was not in scope. Filed by the correcting Dev as: 'Birthday ritual not in scope. Left where it fell.'

relationships.subject: south-quay-claims
relationships.notes: Claims-processing employees, trapped in a bureaucratic contradiction the correction system itself created, organized a walkout. The semantic environment (leave/exit/return/refusal/departure) saturated the building before the chairs did.
